# GitHub Copilot Instructions

## Project Context
**Project:** 3-Zone Sports Fork (Sports Media App)

## Code Style & Conventions
- Use modern JavaScript/TypeScript best practices
- Follow consistent naming conventions (camelCase for variables/functions, PascalCase for classes)
- Write clear comments for complex logic
- Prioritize readability and maintainability

## Testing Guidelines
- Write unit tests for new functions
- Include integration tests for API endpoints
- Aim for >80% code coverage

## Performance & Security
- Optimize database queries
- Implement proper error handling
- Always validate user inputs
- Use environment variables for sensitive data
- Follow OWASP security guidelines

## Documentation
- Document public APIs with JSDoc comments
- Keep README.md up to date
- Add examples for complex features

## Git Workflow
- Create feature branches: `feature/description`
- Write descriptive commit messages
- Keep commits atomic and focused
- Submit PRs with clear descriptions

## AI-Assisted Development
- Use Copilot for boilerplate and repetitive code
- Review all generated code carefully
- Ask Copilot for explanations of complex patterns
- Use Copilot Chat for architecture decisions
